reviews.text:
Saw people putting negative responses to this company
Used them yrs ago when my dog was a new pup
Booked block bookings paid upfront (still to this day) no refund or correspondence to get bk

Then re arranged eventually dates with no shows
Would never recommend this company
Should have checked reviews first instead of being out of pocket
Doesnt answer or responded to calls or emails

I can not recommend John enough. As an ex Army dog trainer, precision and obedience is key. John explains things and demonstrates practices in such easy way to apply.
The things that I have been able to implement after three sessions with my rotweiller has been amazing.
If you find John through research just book him you will find no one better.
I love his very honest and upfront way of teaching and learning which of my behaviours have led to my dogs behaviours.
Thanks John you are one in a million and you truly care never watching the time and always available if something goes wrong to offer advice to implement.

Terrible service, had paid a block booking did maybe half of the ones i had paid for, ive been waiting 3 months now with no info about booking the rest of the block.
